provenance: "This quipu is associated wtih AS59-AS67 / found with a cloth bag at Chala."

cords.name: p40
cords.notes: From the discoloration of the main cord, and by extrapolation based on the spacing of the complete groups, we hypothesize that this quipu contained 24 groups of 8 pendants. Each of the groups had a top cord. Of the original 80 pendants of the first 10 groups, only 35 remain and so the first complete group starts with pendant 36. Of the last 14 groups, no pendants are missing.
